compiled_state.title: [.claude/commands wrappers]: Skill(dso:NAME) called -> Unknown skill error; plugin skills shadowed
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

The 23 wrapper files in `.claude/commands/` (e.g., `fix-bug.md`, `sprint.md`) instruct Claude to invoke the Skill tool with `dso:<name>` namespace. When the wrappers exist, two things happen:

1. The wrapper registers under the bare name (e.g., `fix-bug`), so `Skill("fix-bug")` resolves to the wrapper, not the plugin skill.
2. The plugin's `dso:fix-bug` skill is hidden from the Skill registry — `Skill("dso:fix-bug")` returns "Unknown skill: dso:fix-bug".

The wrapper itself attempts `Skill(/dso:fix-bug)`, fails, and falls through to its 'read the file' branch. Users always go through the slow fallback path.

## Empirical evidence

Tested in this session:
- `Skill("dso:fix-bug")` while wrapper exists → "Unknown skill: dso:fix-bug"
- `rm .claude/commands/fix-bug.md` then `Skill("dso:fix-bug")` (and the new available-skills list shows `dso:fix-bug`, `dso:sprint`, etc.) → resolves cleanly

## Affected files

All 23 files in `.claude/commands/`: architect-foundation.md, brainstorm.md, debug-everything.md, design-review.md, dryrun.md, end-session.md, fix-bug.md, fix-cascade-recovery.md, generate-claude-md.md, implementation-plan.md, init.md, interface-contracts.md, onboarding.md, playwright-debug.md, preplanning.md, quick-ref.md, resolve-conflicts.md, retro.md, review-stats.md, roadmap.md, sprint.md, tickets-health.md, update-docs.md.

## Fix

Delete all 23 wrapper files. The plugin's `dso:*` skills are surfaced as `/dso:<name>` slash commands automatically by Claude Code.
